title: Amery Future Learning Study: code and data for "Future learning and uncertainty reductions in projections of the Amery Ice Shelf catchment, Antarctica"
description:
Code and data accompanying the paper:

Jantre, S., Hoffman, M. J., Zerbe, Z., Urban, N. M., and Hillebrand, T. (2026). Future learning and uncertainty reductions in projections of the Amery Ice Shelf catchment, Antarctica. EGUsphere [preprint], https://doi.org/10.5194/egusphere-2026-1585.

Sequential Bayesian calibration of the MALI ice-sheet model for the Amery Ice Shelf catchment against synthetic future observations, with projection of the catchment's sea-level contribution through 2300. Version 2.0.0 is the revised pipeline for the resubmitted manuscript: four error-model configurations (independent vs. temporally correlated observation error, emulator code uncertainty on/off), scripts, notebooks, emulators, inputs, and the synthetic observations needed to reproduce every figure. Generated outputs are not bundled. See README.md.
